lines.text: Hey Chloe, you heading down to the breakroom for a cup of coffee before the quarterly meeting?
Yeah, I’m dying for a quick cuppa! I’ve been stuck at my desk all morning dealing with heaps of urgent emails.
I hear ya. I’ve been on the phone with clients all day—had to run to the parking garage earlier to grab my portfolio from the trunk.
I parked in the car park too, but I took the lift up. Did you manage to grab some lunch from the cafeteria?
Not yet! I was hoping to grab a sandwich and a soda, but I gotta finish this data entry first.
Fair enough! I brought a sarnie from home, but I need to hit the servo later for petrol and a fizzy drink.
